What can you help my business with?

My main focus is Meta ads for Facebook and Instagram, TikTok ads and Google Ads. I also offer content marketing and separate business analysis projects, including UML, BPMN, swimlanes, process mapping and technical documentation.
I'm not sure which ad platform is right for me. Is that okay?
Absolutely. Select ‘Help me choose’ in the project form. We can look at your audience, offer, business goals, existing assets and budget before deciding which channel deserves attention first.
Do you work with clients internationally?
Yes. I have worked with clients around the world through Upwork, Fiverr, Instagram and LinkedIn. Projects can be delivered remotely, with communication and working arrangements agreed at the start.

I bring together digital marketing, a psychology background and more than two years of business analysis experience. That means looking at the person behind the click, the message they encounter and the process that follows.
What budget do I need, and are results guaranteed?

The right budget depends on the market, offer, channel and scope. Advertising spend is separate from service fees. No specific return, number of leads or sales result is guaranteed; the aim is a clear plan, useful measurement and informed decisions.
What happens after I send a project brief?

Your brief is saved for review. Zainab can use the contact details you provide to discuss the fit, clarify requirements and agree on a proposed scope. Submitting the form does not commit you to a paid service.
